app.title: Parapet Classic
app.subtitle: Extreme running
options.title: Options
mode.desc.sprint: Follow the checkpoints to the goal and beat your rival. The next checkpoint is always shown on screen by an arrow.
mode.desc.flags: Collect the 5 hidden flags before the time runs out. The flags can be collected in any order.
mode.desc.score: Tricks and stunts galore! The key to success is building up the COMBO, so pull off as many tricks as you can on the way to the goal. Whatever you do, don't slow down!
mode.desc.challenge: Your rivals teach you new tricks. Learn them and use them against the rivals!
mode.desc.free: Run with no time limit and practise your moves.
mode.desc.warmup2: Learn to move smoothly and use the surroundings to get an edge.
level.desc.0: This is where we start learning the basics! Spike lives on the rooftops and loves to share his view on life. If you ever need advice, Spike is at your service, up on the roofs.
level.desc.1: The best way to start the morning is to try out new skills in a quiet suburb. "Can you smell the fresh morning dew on the rooftops?"
level.desc.2: The hospital area is Trix's turf. She is new to running but great at clearing walls. "In the urban jungle you can't be cocky. Choose your route wisely."
level.desc.3: It's getting warmer. Main St. is Dart's territory. "I know long tiger jumps make you faster, but I wear glasses and I'm not that reckless!"
level.desc.4: The roofs and courtyard of the old 1960s museum are a great place to polish your jumps.
level.desc.5: Viper's territory. She is a master of tricks over low obstacles. "Style first!"
level.desc.6: Ninja's territory. It is her favourite part of town, with a fine view of the East and her faraway home. "I'm only here to hang out."
level.desc.7: The old Sand Castle tourist trap is a perfect place for real extreme running.
level.desc.8: The low roofs of the Central Park studio complex are run by Big D. "I heard you can jump, but I'd like to see it!" Stay sharp! Big D is very good, and he knows it.
level.desc.9: Finding your way around the warehouses at night is not easy, so stick with Chili. She was a capoeira champion in São Paulo and knows the docks like her own scars.
level.desc.10: The harbour is a dangerous place. Chili knows a couple of secret shortcuts here but is not keen to share them.
level.desc.11: Congratulations! You made it! Only a few steps separate you from the final challenge, but first you must beat Tung. He is the most skilled guy this side of Paris. "Perfection with passion."

player.name: Player
player.playman.desc: Playman is a multi-talented sports superstar. After beach volleyball, football and athletics he has now taken up extreme running!
player.blaise.desc: Playman's sister. She introduced her brother to extreme running and is always ready for action!
moves.run.desc: You never stop running. Plan your moves so you don't have to stop.
moves.landing.desc: Press DOWN on the way down. Land properly when jumping down from a height so you don't stumble.
moves.ladder.desc: To start climbing up, press UP once while hanging on a ladder.
moves.slide.desc: To start sliding down, press DOWN once while hanging on a ladder.
moves.wallJump.desc: Jump at a wall and press BACK just before touching it. Doing several wall jumps between two walls is a technique known as "tic-tac". Use tic-tac to get through narrow alleys.
moves.wallRun.desc: Jump at a wall and press UP 1–3 times just before touching it. This lets you climb tall objects. Combine it with wall jumps and tic-tac to reach hard-to-get places.
moves.ledge.desc: Press UP while hanging on a ledge.
moves.roll.desc: Press DOWN while running. You can get under low objects with a roll.
moves.frontFlip.desc: Jump and press FORWARD to do a front flip. A front flip is quick and earns points. Several flips in one jump earn more points.
moves.backFlip.desc: Jump and press BACK to do a back flip. A back flip is slower but earns more points than a front flip. Several flips in one jump earn more points. Don't try this trick on flat ground unless you are fast enough.
moves.tigerJump.desc: Press FORWARD while running. It earns points and helps you jump further. Overtake rivals with tiger jumps and use them to perform several advanced tricks.
moves.wallFlip.desc: Press FORWARD just before touching a wall while in the air. A wall flip earns lots of points, but it is really dangerous.
moves.monkeyVault.desc: Jump and press UP over a low obstacle. A monkey vault earns lots of points, but it is a difficult trick.
moves.dash.desc: Press DOWN just before an edge to speed up. Dashes earn points.
moves.monkeyFlip.desc: Do a tiger jump just before a low obstacle and press DOWN above it. A monkey flip is a fast way over low objects and earns quite a few points.
moves.spiderJump.desc: Do a tiger jump just before a low obstacle and press UP above it. A spider jump is a fast way over low objects and earns quite a few points.
moves.poleSlide.desc: To grab a pole and slide down, press DOWN just before touching it while in the air.
moves.poleJump.desc: Jump and press FORWARD before touching a pole or while sliding down it.
moves.poleSpin.desc: To change direction quickly, jump and press BACK before touching a pole or while sliding down it.

records.title: Records
hints.wallTurn: Hint: press BACK just before touching a wall to TURN faster and earn points.
hints.landing: Hint: to soften the LANDING, press DOWN before touching the ground.
hints.controls: Learn the basic controls! Use up, left, right and down to move. Running is automatic.
controls.title: Controls
controls.keyboard: Keyboard: arrows or WASD, Enter to confirm, Esc to go back
rules.title: Rules
rules.text:
Meet Playman, his sister Blaise and 8 rivals who share one passion: extreme running!

Beat every rival on time, score and style on the way to the highest rooftops of the city and become the best runner.

In single player you play as Playman or Blaise.

Your character never stops. Plan your moves so you don't have to stop.

Try not to stumble. Land carefully after long jumps.

Pulling off lots of tricks flawlessly builds up the COMBO. The higher the COMBO, the more points you get.

All the moves are listed in the "Moves" menu.
about.title: About
about.text: Parapet Classic is a non-commercial browser remake of Playman Extreme Running, made to keep the game playable and to document how it works.
briefing.sprint: Collect all 5 flags and reach the goal before me. If the route gets too hard, follow me.
briefing.flags: Collect 5 flags before the time runs out. Collect them in any order!
briefing.score:
Score target: {target} points.

Build up your SCORE on the way to the goal for a high result.
briefing.challenge.2: Learn to jump off walls, get the flag and return to the goal!
briefing.challenge.3: Now you will learn a new trick: the WALL FLIP. Get the flag and return to the goal!
briefing.challenge.5: Now you will learn to clear small objects with the MONKEY VAULT, the SPIDER JUMP and the MONKEY FLIP. The arrows will help you on the way.
briefing.challenge.6: Time to dance on the pole! Do a few POLE JUMPS, come down with a POLE SLIDE and turn around with a POLE SPIN.
briefing.challenge.score: Score {target} points in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} to pass this challenge.
tutorial.1.0: Learn the basic controls! Use UP, LEFT, RIGHT and DOWN to move. Running is automatic.
tutorial.1.1: Once you are comfortable with the controls, get the flag and come back to me.
tutorial.1.2: There is no time limit, so practise as long as you like.
tutorial.1.done: Cool! Looks like you are ready for the next challenge! Come back if you want more practice.
tutorial.2.0: Now I will teach you to use the terrain to speed up and move more easily. To help you, I have placed arrows along your path. When you reach an arrow, press the matching key to do the right move.
tutorial.2.1: Get the flag once more and come back to me.
tutorial.2.2: If you miss an arrow, don't worry. Just remember the direction and keep your speed up.
tutorial.2.done: Great! Now you can try the other game modes. Remember to use your surroundings to get an edge. That is what extreme running is all about!
tutorial.2.ps: P.S. You can find every move in the Moves menu.
results.missingMoves.3: Do a WALL FLIP to pass the challenge.
results.missingMoves.5: Do a MONKEY VAULT, a SPIDER JUMP and a MONKEY FLIP to pass the challenge.
results.missingMoves.6: Do a POLE JUMP, a POLE SLIDE and a POLE SPIN to pass the challenge.
results.tooSlow: Too slow this time. Try again.
prize.title: Congratulations!
prize.text: You have completed every mission in the city. Thank you for playing Parapet, a remake of Playman Extreme Running (Mr. Goodliving, 2007). Fonts: Terminus and Russo One.
about.original: Playman Extreme Running (2007) was made by Mr.Goodliving and published by RealNetworks; the game, its graphics, levels and music belong to their rights holders. This project is not affiliated with them.
